title.narrative: Explore opportunities for engaging with the private sector.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the completion of activities to identify and explore potential opportunities for engaging the private sector in project interventions. The findings will inform strategies for public-private partnerships, investment, and sustainable market linkages.

title.narrative: # Community consultation to determine the needs and value chains to be supported/ promoted.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the completion of community consultations to identify priority needs and value chains to be supported or promoted in the target areas. The consultations will ensure participatory decision-making and alignment of project interventions with community priorities and local market potential.

title.narrative: Joint scoping mission/s to the project sites.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the completion of joint scoping missions to project sites to assess local conditions, stakeholder needs, and implementation feasibility. The missions will inform project planning, site selection, and coordination among implementing partners.

title.narrative: Full project proposal prepared and validated through a consultative process.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the preparation and validation of a full project proposal through a consultative process with key stakeholders. The validated proposal will serve as the official roadmap for project implementation and resource mobilization.

title.narrative: Conduct a comprehensive multipurpose agro-market assessment using multi-sector market methodology (capacity of farmers, access to farmlands, ownership, level of vulnerability/risks, beneficiaries' status, similar ongoing interventions, Seeds, farming tools, fertilisers, eligibility of small-scale farmers, etc.) and identify existing extension workers in the project location and youth interns.

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the completion of a comprehensive multipurpose agro-market assessment using a multi-sector market methodology to analyze farmers’ capacity, access to land and inputs, vulnerability and risks, beneficiary eligibility, existing interventions, and market systems in the project areas. It also includes mapping of existing agricultural extension workers and potential youth interns to inform targeting, coordination, and project implementation.

title.narrative: Undertake micro-assessment of the implementing partners to determine the capacity for financial management in accordance with the UNDP HACT framework (MoAI FGS, MoAI Jubaland, National University of Somalia.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the completion of micro-assessments of implementing partners to assess their financial management capacity and risk levels in line with the UNDP Harmonized Approach to Cash Transfers (HACT) framework. The findings will inform risk mitigation measures and appropriate cash transfer modalities for partners, including MoAI FGS, MoAI Jubaland, and the National University of Somalia.
